note: An English-sounding name in deep Gorakhpur.

note: Means chariot. Parking is your problem.

name: Bah
note: Bah. That is the entire name.

name: Chakia
note: Sounds like chakki, the grinding stone.

name: Chauri Chaura
note: A rhyme so good that history textbooks kept it.

name: Sonauli
note: Keep walking and you are in Nepal.
